name: number-input
purpose: Numeric input field with optional increment/decrement spinner buttons. Use when the value is strictly numeric (counts, quantities, ports, thresholds, currency without formatting). Distinct from `input` because it enforces numeric type, supports `min`/`max`/`step`, and renders chevron-up/chevron-down controls on the trailing edge.
useWhen: Capture a strictly numeric value (counts, quantities, ports, prices).
avoidWhen: The value is free text → use `input`.
The user picks from a fixed set of numbers → use `select`.
related: input` — free-text sibling with the same field API.
bestPractices: Set `min` / `max` / `step` to constrain input rather than validating after the fact.
Set `nullable` on an optional field (a port, a limit) so a cleared field stays unset (`null`) instead of falling back to `min ?? 0`.

props.name: placeholder
props.doc: Text shown when the input is empty.

props.name: size
props.doc: Size token; affects height, padding, and typography.

props.name: disabled
props.doc: Disables interaction and applies disabled tokens.

props.name: readonly
props.doc: Marks the field as read-only; spinner buttons are inert.

props.name: required
props.doc: Marks the field as required for assistive tech.

props.name: min
props.doc: Minimum allowed value; spinner stops at this bound.

props.name: max
props.doc: Maximum allowed value; spinner stops at this bound.

props.name: step
props.doc: Increment used by the spinner buttons and arrow keys.

props.name: nullable
props.doc: Lets a cleared field emit null instead of falling back to min or 0.

events.name: change
events.notes: Emitted when the user commits the value (blur or Enter). With `nullable` the payload is `null` when the field is committed empty.

slots.name: suffix
slots.notes: Content rendered after the input, before the spinner buttons (e.g. `%`).
